comment: Paired DocxEditorProps / DocxEditorRef members across the React and Vue adapters.

vueExclusive.class: Vue sugar host declares `class` on DocxEditorProps; React names the same surface `className`.
vueExclusive.revisionStyles: Per-author revision styling. React expresses it DECLARATIVELY — `DocxEditor.ColorByChangeType` / `DocxEditor.AuthorStyle` components over the shared instance API (`setRevisionStyles`, `getReviewAuthors`) — so it deliberately has no React prop. Vue has no declarative twin yet and keeps the prop; the ENGINE half is one implementation either way.

frameworkLocalTypeAliases.DocxEditorChildren: React uses ReactNode; Vue uses VNode for slot and icon content.

ref.comment: Greenfield DocxEditorRef is the SAME interface on both adapters.
